Your assistant (hermes) wants to install "Agenda" (version 1) in hermes--personal: it reads your calendar through the server "calendar" at https://cal.example/mcp (it works with a server that offers calendar_list_events), and returns your events for a day or a week with their time, title, kind of place, number of attendees and conflicts; never a description or an attendee's address. It uses the credential CALENDAR_TOKEN; you enter any that is not set yet on your phone after you approve.
